name: ANSI/IEEE Two-pole power switch form
summary: IEEE-library form of two-pole power switch: a two-pole power switch operates two circuit conductors through a common device.
description: This reference locates two-pole power switch in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented power switches family. A two-pole power switch operates two circuit conductors through a common device. The schematic may use separate pole elements linked by a mechanism annotation. The public library uses HCB11Q50 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Read the operating mechanism and the contact reference state together. Cross-reference every associated contact to the same device and show which movement, signal or reset changes its condition; the symbol alone does not establish the complete switching sequence.

Identify whether the two poles are phases, a phase and neutral, or DC conductors. Two poles do not necessarily mean a two-phase supply. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
